title: Chinese scientists discover “D-rex,” a giant fungus with roots stretching back 65 million years
caption:
A newly identified fungus called D-rex reaches nearly 20 inches in height. Genetic analysis suggests its family lineage traces back to the period immediately following the dinosaur extinction.

Source: Sciencedaily - Chinese scientists discover “D-rex,” a giant fungus with roots stretching back 65 million years
